Proof in the paper: For the Ni/SiO2-IMP catalyst, three peaks centered at 44.47°, 51.85°, and 76.34° were found, which could be assigned to (111), (200), and (220) of face-centered cubic (fcc) nickel, respectively. No signals of nickel hydroxide or nickel oxide were observed. The XRD pattern of Co/SiO2-IMP had three peaks at 44.33°, 51.57°, and 75.89°, corresponding to (111), (200), and (220) of fcc cobalt, respectively. For NiCo/SiO2-IMP, the XRD peaks occurred at 44.44°, 51.72°, and 76.30°, similar to those of either fcc Ni or fcc Co.
